summary_1line: After meeting Sita, Hanuman decides the best strategy is force and plans to provoke the rakshasas by attacking the Ashoka grove to assess their strength.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman stands in the Ashoka grove after speaking with Sita, eyes blazing as he resolves to challenge Ravana's warriors.
Perched among the trees of the Ashoka grove, Hanuman contemplates provoking Ravana's army to reveal its power.
